query:
SELECT `minConfidenceThreshold`, COUNT(*) AS `watchlistCount`
FROM `watchlists`
GROUP BY `minConfidenceThreshold`
ORDER BY `minConfidenceThreshold`;
SELECT `id`, `riskProfileId`, `minConfidence`, `status`, `totalRoundsCompleted`, `totalTradesExecuted`
FROM `scheduled_simulator_runs`
ORDER BY `id`;
